phases: Phase 2: Wire the gate into the CI bench job

limitations: Run-over-run perf-regression gate: cache main baseline, restore on PR, fail on >2.0x median regression. No source/bench-logic change; no committed absolute baseline.
non_goals: No per-bench thresholds, no critcmp/external service, no change to which benches run.
exclusions: No lint/test/features job change; no Rust source change.
